name: Roaring Wilds
description:
They tread upon home, upon family, upon foe. They salted the soil, dumped bodies in the river... They are everywhere.
<Hidden Tunnel> Toggles the standby/deployed status of Miner Guerrillas assembled here.

<Rock Wall> Units cannot be deployed on this tile.
